name_original: Microsoft - Arc Touch Bluetooth Wireless Mouse - Gray
description_original: Enjoy control from up to 30' away with this Microsoft Arc Touch 7MP-00001 mouse, which features Bluetooth 4.0 for use with select Windows devices. The 3-button, ambidextrous design also includes a touch scroll strip to offer flexibility.
